note: Every feature that lowers generation at its high value (T&D losses included, at their upper bound); the rest at central.

note: Every feature that raises generation at its high value and every one that lowers it at its low value (T&D losses at 0).

name: All downside
note: Every feature that raises generation at its low value and every one that lowers it at its high value (T&D losses at their upper bound).
